cities.government_boundary: Lagos State is the narrowest defensible published fiscal anchor, but it is not coextensive with the UN Degree-of-Urbanization Lagos built-up area and contains multiple local government areas.
cities.source_format: official Lagos State NCOA-coded PDF budget-performance report; federal Open Treasury XLSX/TXT/PDF exports are out of scope
cities.blocker: Lagos State publishes genuine NCOA-coded 2025 budget/execution lines, but the reviewed official publication is PDF rather than a machine-readable CSV/XLSX/API. Nigeria's Open Treasury exports are explicitly Federal Government of Nigeria financial activities; Lagos-named federal pay offices and MDAs therefore are not Lagos State or local-government accounts. No official machine-readable Lagos State/LGA line endpoint was verified. Successful cloud discovery build 58752047-9288-439d-b697-3cfb396c9572 found no structured or budget links on the official Lagos State landing page; the MEPB root returned 404 and both federal Open Treasury probes timed out after 90 seconds. Zero rows were loaded.
